Number(v) : f.type === "checkbox" ? v === "on" : v; } setBusy(true); setMessage(""); setFailed(false); try { await requestJson("/api/qbuy", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ operation, data }) }); // Acknowledged commands get a fresh key.
